batch: Sysinternals Windows 11 package migration scope reconciliation

userDecision.workflow: RIDE downloads from Microsoft and installs/stages for the user's own device; RIDE does not transfer or publish Sysinternals copies.

suite.scope: Pinned 164-member snapshot selection, preview, install, repeat, removal, saved-state restore, prior absence, unowned-file preservation, collision refusal and modified-file preservation.

independentProducts.scope: The nine separately selectable product packages completed package file lifecycle and recovery.

licenseDisposition.result: All ten exact-version package records are Reviewed; the prior RIDE v2 specialist approval settles direct download-and-install.

scopeDecision.accepted: The legacy Sysinternals Suite download/install package outcome is complete for its declared Windows 11 file lifecycle.
scopeDecision.packageLifecycleBoundary: RIDE manages pinned file acquisition/staging, repeat install, removal and saved-state recovery. Executing utility features is outside package install lifecycle acceptance.
separateScope: Windows Server support remains undeclared and unaccepted.
Defender-blocked utility names remain excluded from staging and acceptance.

Tool-specific actions such as driver/service installation, process changes, disk imaging and remote reputation queries remain outside package staging and require their own explicitly selected workflow.

resolved: One legacy product outcome: Sysinternals Suite download/install package lifecycle on Windows 11.
deferred: No Windows Server target is declared for these packages; no claim is made about the runtime feature behavior of any utility.

estimates.adjustment: Package estimate reduced by one legacy product outcome. The nine additional selectable package IDs are not counted as nine separate legacy outcomes. The rounded range remains 125-180/about 155.
